name: AbbVie Inc.
summary:
AbbVie (ABBV) reported earnings of $3.82 per share on revenue of $17.40 billion for the third quarter ended September 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $3.74 per share on revenue of $17.37 billion. The company beat consensus estimates by 2.14% while revenue grew 10.32% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it now expects 2026 non-GAAP earnings of $13.95 to $13.99 per share. The company's previous guidance was non-GAAP earnings of $13.87 to $14.07 per share. The current consensus earnings estimate is $13.95 per share for the year ending December 31, 2026.

AbbVie Inc is a research-based biopharmaceutical company. Its products are used to treat diseases including rheumatoid arthritis, psoriasis, Crohn' disease, HIV, cystic fibrosis complications.
subject: AbbVie Beat Consensus Estimates, Narrows Guidance

name: Canadian National Railway Company
summary:
Canadian National Railway (CNI) reported earnings of $1.54 per share on revenue of $3.41 billion for the third quarter ended September 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $1.49 per share on revenue of $3.27 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $1.49 per share. The company beat expectations by 3.36% while revenue grew 12.73% on a year-over-year basis.

The company said it continues to expect 2026 earnings of $5.68 to $5.95 per share. The current consensus earnings estimate is $5.80 per share for the year ending December 31, 2026.

CN powers the economy by safely transporting more than 300 million tons of natural resources, manufactured products, and finished goods throughout North America every year for its customers.
subject: Canadian National Railway Beat Expectations, Reaffirms

name: Cameco Corporation
summary:
Cameco (CCJ) reported breakeven results on revenue of $442.40 million for the third quarter ended September 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $0.23 per share. The Earnings Whisper number was $0.20 per share. The company missed expectations by 100.00% while revenue fell 0.87% compared to the same quarter a year ago.

“We continue to be guided by our disciplined strategy and the strength of our diversified nuclear energy platform,” said Tim Gitzel, Cameco’s CEO. “Results for the quarter and the first nine months of 2026 were lower than the comparable period last year, largely due to a few significant items that affected year-over-year comparisons. We planned a longer maintenance outage at the Key Lake mill this year to undertake projects that are intended to ensure flexibility and sustainable operations, and as we expected, that outage, which began during the third quarter, resulted in lower production volume and higher costs this quarter. "

Cameco Corp is engaged in the exploration for and the development, mining, refining, conversion, fabrication and trading of uranium for sale as fuel for generating electricity in nuclear power reactors in Canada and other countries.
subject: Cameco Missed Expectations

name: Exxon Mobil Corporation
summary:
Exxon Mobil (XOM) reported earnings of $4.23 per share on revenue of $113.16 billion for the third quarter ended September 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $3.90 per share on revenue of $102.98 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $4.21 per share. The company beat expectations by 0.48% while revenue grew 32.68% on a year-over-year basis.

"In the third quarter, we continued to rise to the challenge of meeting global energy needs, drawing on unmatched scale, integration, and technical capabilities,” said Darren Woods, ExxonMobil chairman and chief executive officer. “We're increasing production while improving efficiency - the result of years of consistent and disciplined investment and execution excellence. On the U.S. Gulf Coast, investments such as our Beaumont refinery expansion have contributed to an increase in our distillate production by approximately 40% since 2019."

Exxon Mobil Corporation is engaged in energy, involving exploration for, and production of, crude oil and natural gas, manufacture of petroleum products and transportation and sale of crude oil, natural gas and petroleum products.
subject: Exxon Mobil Beat Expectations

name: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals, Inc.
summary:
Regeneron Pharmaceuticals (REGN) reported earnings of $20.07 per share on revenue of $5.12 billion for the third quarter ended September 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $16.11 per share on revenue of $4.55 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $16.79 per share. The company beat expectations by 19.54% while revenue grew 36.27% on a year-over-year basis.

Regeneron Pharmaceuticals Inc is a fully integrated biopharmaceutical company. It discovers, invents, develops, manufactures, and commercializes medicines for the treatment of serious medical conditions.
subject: Regeneron Pharmaceuticals Beat Expectations

name: Chevron Corporation
summary:
Chevron (CVX) reported earnings of $5.28 per share on revenue of $67.80 billion for the third quarter ended September 2026. The consensus earnings estimate was $4.78 per share on revenue of $60.49 billion. The Earnings Whisper number was $4.94 per share. The company beat expectations by 6.88% while revenue grew 36.34% on a year-over-year basis.

“We delivered strong operational performance and disciplined execution, while continuing to invest to grow energy supply,” said Mike Wirth, Chevron’s chairman and chief executive officer. In the United States, for third quarter 2026, upstream production exceeded 2 million barrels of oil equivalent per day for the fifth consecutive quarter, the company’s refineries achieved record crude throughput, and new production records were achieved for assets in the Eastern Mediterranean, and Australia.

Chevron Corp provides administrative, financial, management and technology support to U.S. & international subsidiaries that engage in fully integrated petroleum operations, chemicals operations, mining operations, and power and energy services.
subject: Chevron Beat Expectations
